what_v36_adds: real per-date Sentinel-2 scene stack fetcher using existing AgriBrain eo.sentinel auth and Process API
candidate scene selection from existing fetch_ndvi_timeseries
per-scene NDVI, NDMI, structure proxy, valid mask
metadata/zero baseline, global phase-style, local tile-based, and hybrid-gated shift models
internal validation selection plus final holdout evaluation
why_not_live_run_here: This environment is not guaranteed to have the user's Sentinel Hub/CDSE credentials or external network. The script is designed to run locally from services/agribrain where the user's .env works.
v36_verdict: Implementation-ready real-data prototype. Full scientific verdict requires running the script locally with Sentinel access.
